frames.title: Lesson 109 · Reporting passive — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Reporting passive — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** anúncio, folheto, aviso.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar a passiva de relato com a fala direta e com a voz passiva simples, em um aviso público.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Public Notice: Winter Shelter
lines: The winter shelter **is expected to open** on 1 December. The building **is said to have been** unused for years, but it **is now known to be** safe. Around eighty beds **are reported to be** ready.
Volunteers **are believed to be needed** most on weekends. The council **is understood to have approved** extra funding. **It is hoped that** local businesses will donate blankets.

items.q: The shelter is expected to open on 1 December.
The building is known to be unsafe.
Local businesses have already donated blankets.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
Sentido
rows: They say the building is safe.
The building **is said to be** safe.
The building **is said to have been** unused.

blocks.body: Passiva de relato = **fonte vaga + informação importante**. Use *to have + particípio* quando a ação é **anterior**.
✗ *It is said to open soon that…* (misturou as estruturas: *It is said that…* **ou** *X is said to…*).

items.s: The shelter is ___ to open on 1 December. (expect)
The building is said to have ___ unused. (be)
Around eighty beds are ___ to be ready. (report)
It is hoped ___ businesses will donate. (that)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Let us confirm that on Monday

body: **It is hoped that…** — Espera-se que…
**It is widely believed that…** — Acredita-se amplamente que…
**It is generally accepted that…** — É geralmente aceito que…
**It has been suggested that…** — Foi sugerido que…
**It remains to be seen.** — Resta ver.
**It goes without saying that…** — Nem é preciso dizer que…
**It is no secret that…** — Não é segredo que…
**It is understood that…** — Entende-se que…
**Is the shelter ready?** — O abrigo está pronto?
**Eighty beds are reported to be available.** — Oitenta camas são relatadas como disponíveis.
**Let us confirm that on Monday.** — Vamos confirmar isso na segunda-feira.

blocks.title: Volunteers briefing
lines: It is said to be ready, but nobody has checked.
Diz-se que está pronto, mas ninguém verificou.
Eighty beds are reported to be available.
Oitenta camas são relatadas como disponíveis.
Let us confirm that on Monday.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.q: Report a rumour about a building.
prompts.model: The building is said to be safe.
It is believed to have been closed for years.

prompts.q: Contrast direct speech and the reporting passive.
prompts.model: They say it is safe → It is said to be safe.

blocks.task: Write a public notice of 5 sentences using at least three reporting passives.
blocks.model: Public Notice: Community Kitchen. The kitchen is expected to reopen on Monday. It is said to have been closed for repairs. About fifty meals are reported to be prepared daily. Volunteers are believed to be needed in the evenings. It is hoped that local shops will donate food.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
